# Fixtures for `docx` (Word document)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. People, places,
companies and addresses (Saltmere, `example.org`, `*.example`) are fictitious.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `ferry-textutil.docx` | Converted by macOS `textutil` from `scripts/fixtures/documents/ferry.html` (`scripts/fixtures/documents.sh`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `letter.docx` | Assembled part by part by `scripts/fixtures/craft_documents.py` | CC0-1.0 |
| `review.docx` | Assembled part by part by `scripts/fixtures/craft_documents.py` | CC0-1.0 |
| `notice-docxrs.docx` | Written by the docx-rs crate (`scripts/fixtures/office_gen`); headings, a table, a link, a comment, a custom property | CC0-1.0 |
